result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a few visible viewport and overflow issues affecting content visibility.

issues.description: The category chip row is visibly clipped on the right: Healthy is near the edge and part of another chip is cut off.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has intentional scroll behavior and a clear visual affordance, or adjust spacing so the clipping feels deliberate.

issues.description: The Fastest near you restaurant carousel cuts off the third restaurant card at the right edge, leaving its name and image partially hidden.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent horizontal carousel treatment with a visible peek, scroll indicator, or appropriate padding to communicate that more cards are available.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the second Popular right now card, obscuring its lower content and potentially making the card details inaccessible without scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or ensure the bottom navigation does not cover active content.
